stories.title: The little chef
scenes: It was Mum's birthday, and Noah woke up very early.
He mixed eggs, flour and milk. There was flour everywhere!
Then he cooked the pancakes very carefully.
The kitchen was a mess, but the pancakes looked perfect.
'Happy birthday, Mum!' he said.
Mum laughed and gave him a big hug. 'The best breakfast ever!'

stories.title: The new neighbour
scenes: One morning, a big van stopped next to Sam's house.
A new girl called Yuki sat alone on the steps. She looked a little sad.
Suddenly, Sam's football flew over the fence!
Yuki smiled and kicked it back. 'Nice kick!' said Sam.
Soon they were playing football together.
Now Sam and Yuki are best friends.

stories.title: The lost ticket
scenes: Grandma Ella was going to visit her family by train.
At the platform, she opened her bag. Her ticket wasn't there!
In the café, a young man saw a ticket under a table.
He ran along the platform to find its owner.
'Is this yours?' he asked. 'Oh, thank you!' said Grandma Ella.
She waved from the window as the train left.

stories.title: The broken bike
scenes: Zara loved riding her bike after school.
One day, the front tyre was flat. 'Oh no!' she said.
She pushed her bike to Mr Brown's shop.
'Let me show you how to fix it,' said Mr Brown.
Zara watched, and then she did it herself!
Now she can fix her bike on her own.

stories.title: The surprise
scenes: Ben had a secret plan: it was Mrs Green's last day before she retired.
At break time, the class made a big card.
They hid balloons and a cake behind the door.
When Mrs Green came in, everyone shouted, 'Surprise!'
She read the card and smiled. 'Thank you, my dear class.'
Then everyone had a piece of cake.

stories.title: The sunflower
scenes: Grandad gave Tom a very small seed.
Tom put it in some soil by the window.
Every morning, he gave it some water.
The plant grew and grew. Soon it was as tall as Tom!
In summer, it was a giant sunflower.
'You can grow great things from a small seed,' said Grandad.
